body:
My IGM is StrafePvP__, I was recently banned on the avic.us, I was idling, in a map called Zao TDM01 I think, for maybe 5-10 minutes when I had come back it had said I was banned for forcefield. So when I try join again it says, 'You have been punished by SnowSX3 for Hacking-Forcefield'. I would really appreciate it if I was given more information about this reason for being banned. I do not have any evidence at all to support my case, but I really wish you guys could understand that I was not hacking using 'forcefield'.

Thank You,
StrafePvP__

;D

And what does the archive button mean below? v v v v :/
